description: This Java class, ProcessInfo, extends Android's Activity class and is responsible for displaying information about a specific process, including its name and associated package list. It retrieves data from intent extras and dynamically updates the UI elements.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: An activity that displays process name and a list of packages associated with that process.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves process information from intent extras, and populates the UI with process name and package list.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume; currently just calls super implementation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles activity stop; currently just calls super implementation.
